pictures.name: ZSL1-Buffaloes
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. Hot pastures beyond a Punjab village in the late 1400s, heat haze shimmering: a teenage boy in a simple white kurta, seen only from directly behind, his head turned fully away (he is the young Guru Nanak; no face, profile or cheek is ever visible), walks behind a few big black water buffaloes with a thin stick over his shoulder. Dry gold grass, a single big tree ahead. Even the birds are quiet.
